how_we_work.method: Python patcher scripts — three-block PowerShell format
how_we_work.block2: Full Python patcher code (copy into opened file and save)
how_we_work.block3: py patcher_NN_name.py; Remove-Item patcher_NN_name.py; git add ...; git commit -m '...'; git pull --rebase origin main; git push
how_we_work.pre_check: ALWAYS request current file via GitHub API before writing patcher. NEVER assume local state.
how_we_work.post_check: After deploy, request updated file via API to confirm SHA and correctness.

patcher_safety_rules.repr_before_patcher: ALWAYS read target lines via python3 -c "with open('bot.py', encoding='utf-8') as f: lines=f.readlines(); print(repr(lines[N]))" before building anchors.
patcher_safety_rules.check_logs_after_restart: ALWAYS append log check after systemctl restart. Pattern: ssh root@91.99.149.226 "cd /opt/mandala && git pull && systemctl restart mandala-bot && journalctl -u mandala-bot -n 50 --no-pager"
patcher_safety_rules.no_cyrillic_in_strings: Cyrillic in patchers only via unicode-escapes: \u041d\u0435 instead of direct text.
patcher_safety_rules.syntax_check_mandatory: python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read()); print('Syntax OK')" before every commit.
patcher_safety_rules.anchor_by_content: Anchors by string content, never by line number.
patcher_safety_rules.assert_before_replace: assert old in src before every replace.
